findings.title: p-value does not follow from its test statistic
findings.quote: The difference was significant ( t = 1.20 , p = 0.003 ).
findings.context: ants gave a mean usefulness rating of 5.19 on a 1--7 scale. Our model reached an accuracy of 0.847 (Table [tab:main]). The ensemble outperformed the strongest baseline by 1.4 points (95% CI -0.3 to 3.1). The difference was significant ( t = 1.20 , p = 0.003 ). Calibration improved across horizons (Figure [fig:cal]d), with Brier scores listed in the released results.
findings.evidence: t = 1.20 cannot give p = 0.003: whatever the degrees of freedom, its two-sided p is at least .228. The result is not significant at 0.05.
findings.fix: Recompute p from t and its degrees of freedom, and report the degrees of freedom.

findings.title: Released result file that no test reads
findings.evidence: The manuscript prints 4 values held in results/main_table.csv (0.774, 0.802, 0.812, 0.851), and no shipped test names that file: the page and the file can drift apart while every test still passes.
findings.fix: Add a test that regenerates the file from code/ and data/, or that reads it and checks the values the manuscript prints.

findings.title: Claim stronger than its own interval
findings.quote: The ensemble outperformed the strongest baseline by 1.4 points (95% CI -0.3 to 3.1).
findings.context: Results: The N=18 participants gave a mean usefulness rating of 5.19 on a 1--7 scale. Our model reached an accuracy of 0.847 (Table [tab:main]). The ensemble outperformed the strongest baseline by 1.4 points (95% CI -0.3 to 3.1). The difference was significant ( t = 1.20 , p = 0.003 ). Calibration improved across horizons (Figure [fig:cal]d), with Brier scores listed in the released results.
findings.evidence: The sentence asserts a direction ('outperformed') but its own evidence does not exclude no effect: 95% CI -0.3 to 3.1 includes 0. Either the comparative word predates the current numbers or the claim overreaches the test.
findings.fix: Reword to what the interval supports (no detectable difference / direction not established), or report the test that does exclude zero
